title: Minimax estimation of the pseudo-spectral gap of continuous Markov chains, with applications to empirical concentration bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.20007v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the minimax estimation of the pseudo-spectral gap $\gamma_{ps}$ of a Markov chain from the observation of a single trajectory. Extending earlier works on finite-state space chains by Wolfer and Kontorovich (2024), we provide an estimator in the case of a compact, continuous state-space. Our estimator appears to be minimax-optimal on the class of chains with a transition operator with Lipschitz density, up to logarithmic terms. Our estimator, combined with Paulin's version of Bernstein inequality, allows to derive empirical concentration inequalities for Markov chains. This unlocks many applications, from confidence intervals, to active learning and generalization bounds. In particular, for rested bandits with Markov rewards, we provide a version of UCB with a regret bound similar to the one in the iid case, without assuming any knowledge on the pseudo-spectral gap of the chains.

translated_title: 连续马尔可夫链伪谱隙的极小极大估计及其在经验集中界中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究了基于单条轨迹观测来对马尔可夫链伪谱隙 $\gamma_{ps}$ 进行极小极大估计的问题。通过扩展 Wolfer 和 Kontorovich (2024) 关于有限状态空间链的早期工作，我们针对紧致连续状态空间的情形提出了一个估计器。在转移算子具有 Lipschitz 密度的链类上，我们的估计器在相差对数因子的意义下似乎是极小极大最优的。将该估计器与 Paulin 版本的 Bernstein 不等式相结合，可以为马尔可夫链推导出经验集中不等式。这开启了许多应用，包括置信区间、主动学习和泛化界。特别地，对于具有马尔可夫奖励的静止老虎机问题，我们提出了一个 UCB 算法版本，其遗憾界与独立同分布情形类似，且无需对链的伪谱隙有任何先验知识。
tldr: 本文提出了紧致连续状态空间马尔可夫链伪谱隙的首个极小极大最优估计器，结合 Bernstein 不等式推导出经验集中不等式，并据此在无需伪谱隙先验知识的情况下，为马尔可夫奖励老虎机问题给出了具有接近独立同分布情形遗憾界的 UCB 算法。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first minimax-optimal estimator of the pseudo-spectral gap for Markov chains with compact continuous state spaces, derives empirical concentration inequalities via Bernstein's inequality, and yields a UCB algorithm for rested bandits with Markov rewards achieving iid-like regret bounds without prior knowledge of the pseudo-spectral gap.
